title: Propagation of Chaos on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: We extend reflection coupling for uniform-in-time propagation of chaos from Euclidean space to complete Riemannian manifolds. Intrinsic reflection along minimizing geodesics replaces the Euclidean difference process, and the associated endpoint-index term quantifies the competition between curvature, confinement, and interaction. Under an endpoint-index bound and a radial Laplacian bound, we establish global well-posedness, uniform moment estimates, and uniform-in-time propagation of chaos with rate $N^{-1/2}$ in a modified Wasserstein distance.
